statement:
∀ (x : ℝ),
  deriv (fun x => rexp (-x ^ 2) * sin (rexp (x ^ 2))) x =
    -2 * x * rexp (-x ^ 2) * sin (rexp (x ^ 2)) + 2 * x * cos (rexp (x ^ 2))
